import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:500]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:500])
    else: print('ok  ',name)

def base(**kw):
    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc

def chan(name, parts, cases=(), events=(), frames=None):
    if frames is None:
        frames=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}]
    return base(cases=[{"name":c,"frames":frames,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}} for c in cases],
                events=list(events),
                channels=[{"name":name,"parts":[{"case":o,"data":d} for o,d in parts]}])

def request(method=b'GET', target=b'/', headers=(), version=b'HTTP/1.1'):
    line = method+b' '+target+b' '+version+b'\r\n'
    block = b''.join(n+b':'+v+b'\r\n' for n,v in headers)
    return line+block+b'\r\n'

def rec(name, parts, cases=(), frames=None):
    r = run(json.dumps(chan(name, parts, cases, frames=frames)))
    return r['channels'][0], r['cases']

# --- simple length request, no CL/TE
c,_ = rec('e',[('a', request())])
check('no framing', (c['error'], c['committed']), (None,[1]))
q=c['requests'][0]
check('no framing offsets', (q['start'],q['end']), (0,len(request())))
check('no framing framing', q['framing'], 'none')
check('no framing body', q['body'], fp(b''))
check('no framing host', (q['host_count'],q['host']), (0,fp(b'')))
check('no framing flags', q['flags'], ['missing_host','identity','unattributed'])

# --- headers fingerprint with trimming and spelling preserved
raw = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost:   Example.COM  \r\nX-A: v\r\nX-B:\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
q=c['requests'][0]
check('trim host', q['host'], fp(b'example.com'))
check('header block fp', q['headers'], fp(field_block([(b'Host',b'Example.COM'),(b'X-A',b'v'),(b'X-B',b'')])))
check('header interior kept', True, True)
raw2 = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nX-A:  a  b\tc  \r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw2)])
check('interior bytes', c['requests'][0]['headers'], fp(field_block([(b'X-A',b'a  b\tc')])))
check('host missing', c['requests'][0]['host_count'], 0)

# --- content length forms
for value, blen, ok in [(b'5',5,True),(b' 5 ',5,True),(b'0005',5,True),(b'5 , 5',5,True),
                        (b'5,5,5',5,True),(b'0',0,True),(b'',None,False),(b'5,',None,False),
                        (b'5,6',None,False),(b'x',None,False),(b'-1',None,False),(b'+5',None,False),
                        (b'9223372036854775808',None,False),(b'9223372036854775807',None,False)]:
    body = b'ABCDE'
    raw = request(headers=[(b'Content-Length',value)]) + (body[:blen] if ok else b'')
    c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
    if ok:
        q=c['requests'][0]
        check('cl '+repr(value), (q['framing'],q['body'],c['error']), ('length',fp(body[:blen]),None))
    else:
        check('cl bad '+repr(value), c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

# --- duplicate content-length fields must agree
raw = request(headers=[(b'Content-Length',b'2'),(b'CONTENT-LENGTH',b' 2 ')]) + b'hi'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('dup cl agree', (c['error'],c['requests'][0]['framing'],c['requests'][0]['body']), (None,'length',fp(b'hi')))
raw = request(headers=[(b'Content-Length',b'2'),(b'Content-Length',b'3')]) + b'hi'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('dup cl conflict', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

# --- transfer-encoding
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')]) + b'3\r\nabc\r\n0\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
q=c['requests'][0]
check('te chunked', (c['error'],q['framing'],q['body'],q['trailers']), (None,'chunked',fp(b'abc'),fp(field_block([]))))
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b' CHUNKED ')]) + b'0\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('te chunked folded', (c['error'],c['requests'][0]['framing']), (None,'chunked'))
for te in [b'identity', b'gzip', b'chunked, gzip', b'']:
    raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',te)])
    c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
    check('te bad '+repr(te), c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked'),(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')])
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('te twice', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked'),(b'Content-Length',b'1')]) + b'1'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('te+cl', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

# --- chunked details
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'CHUNKED')]) + b'A;p q\r\n0123456789\r\n0\r\nX: y\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
q=c['requests'][0]
check('chunk hex+suffix+trailer', (c['error'],q['body'],q['trailers']), (None,fp(b'0123456789'),fp(field_block([(b'X',b'y')]))))
check('chunk end offset', q['end'], len(request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'CHUNKED')]))+len(b'A;p q\r\n0123456789\r\n0\r\nX: y\r\n\r\n'))
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')]) + b'0\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('chunk zero only', (c['error'],c['requests'][0]['body']), (None,fp(b'')))
for bad in [b'x\r\n0\r\n\r\n', b'g\r\n0\r\n\r\n', b' 1\r\nx\r\n0\r\n\r\n', b'1 ;\x01\r\nx\r\n0\r\n\r\n',
            b'1;x\r0\r\nx\r\n0\r\n\r\n']:
    raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')]) + bad
    c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
    check('chunk bad '+repr(bad), c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
# chunk data terminator
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')]) + b'1\r\naX0\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('chunk bad crlf', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
# incomplete variants
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')]) + b'3\r\nab'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('chunk short data', c['error'], {'kind':'incomplete','offset':0})
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')]) + b'3\r\nabc\r'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('chunk short crlf', c['error'], {'kind':'incomplete','offset':0})
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')]) + b'0\r\nT: v\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('chunk unfinished trailer', c['error'], {'kind':'incomplete','offset':0})
# forbidden trailer names
for bad in [b'Host: h', b'Content-Length: 1', b'TRANSFER-ENCODING: chunked']:
    raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')]) + b'0\r\n'+bad+b'\r\n\r\n'
    c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
    check('trailer forbidden '+repr(bad), c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')]) + b'0\r\nX: 1\r\nX: 2\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('trailer duplicates kept', c['requests'][0]['trailers'], fp(field_block([(b'X',b'1'),(b'X',b'2')])))

# --- request line rules
for line, ok in [(b'GET / HTTP/1.1',True),(b'GET  / HTTP/1.1',False),(b'GET /  HTTP/1.1',False),
                 (b'GET / HTTP/1.0',False),(b'GET / HTTP/2',False),(b' / HTTP/1.1',False),
                 (b'GET /HTTP/1.1',False),(b'G@T / HTTP/1.1',False),(b'GET /a b HTTP/1.1',False),
                 (b'GET /\t HTTP/1.1',False),(b'G ET / HTTP/1.1',False),(b'GETT!#$%&\'*+-.^_`|~0 / HTTP/1.1',True)]:
    raw = line+b'\r\n\r\n'
    c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
    if ok:
        check('reqline '+repr(line), c['error'], None)
    else:
        check('reqline '+repr(line), c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

# --- header line rules
for hl, ok in [(b'Host: h',True),(b'Host:h',True),(b'Host : h',False),(b'Host',False),
               (b':v',False),(b'H@: v',False),(b'H: \x01',False),(b'H: \x7f',False),(b'H: \x80',False),
               (b'H: ok\tok',True),(b'H:\r',True),(b'\x00: v',False)]:
    raw = request(headers=[hl]) if ok else b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n'+hl+b'\r\n\r\n'
    c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
    check('hdr '+repr(hl), c['error'], None if ok else {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

# --- host counts
raw = request(headers=[(b'Host',b'a'),(b'HOST',b'b')])
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('multiple host', (c['requests'][0]['host_count'],c['requests'][0]['host'],c['requests'][0]['flags']),
      (2,fp(b''),['identity','missing_origin'[:0] or 'multiple_host','unattributed']))
raw = request(headers=[(b'Host',b'A')])
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('one host', (c['requests'][0]['host'],c['requests'][0]['host_count']), (fp(b'a'),1))

# --- line limits
c,_ = rec('e',[('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8186+b' HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n')])
check('line 8192 ok', c['error'], None)
c,_ = rec('e',[('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8187+b' HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n')])
check('line 8193 syntax', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
c,_ = rec('e',[('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8186+b' HTTP/1.1\r')][:1])
check('line 8193 unfinished', run(json.dumps(chan('e',[('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8186+b' HTTP/1.1\r')]['x'=='x' and [('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8186+b' HTTP/1.1\r')] if False else [('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8186+b' HTTP/1.1\r')]))))['channels'][0]['error'], {'kind':'incomplete','offset':0})
c,_ = rec('e',[('a', b'GET /'+b'a'*8200+b' HTTP/1.1')])
check('line 8205 no lf syntax', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
c,_ = rec('e',[('a', b'GET /\nHTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n')])
check('bare lf', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
c,_ = rec('e',[('a', b'\r\n\r\n')])
check('bare lf first', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

# --- block limits
big_line = b'GET /'+b'a'*(8192-4)+b' HTTP/1.1\r\n'
parts = [big_line]
total = len(big_line)
headers=[]
while total + 2 <= 65536-2:
    headers.append(b'X'+b'y'*30+b':v')
    total += len(headers[-1])+2
raw = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n'+b''.join(h+b'\r\n' for h in headers)
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('block size boundary', c['error'], None if len(raw)+2 <= 65536 else {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
print('   block raw len', len(raw))
raw2 = raw[:-2]+b'\r\n'+b'X:1\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw2)])
check('block size exceeded', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
# 128 fields boundary
hdrs128 = b''.join(b'X%d:v\r\n'%i for i in range(128))
raw = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n'+hdrs128+b'\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('128 fields ok', c['error'], None)
raw = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n'+hdrs128+b'X:v\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('129 fields syntax', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})
# trailer block limits
tr = b''.join(b'X%d:v\r\n'%i for i in range(128))
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')])+b'0\r\n'+tr+b'\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('128 trailer fields ok', c['error'], None)
raw = request(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding',b'chunked')])+b'0\r\n'+tr+b'X:v\r\n\r\n'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('129 trailer fields', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

# --- incomplete / multi request boundaries
raw = request()+request()
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('two requests', (c['error'],c['committed'],len(c['requests'])), (None,[1],2))
check('second start', (c['requests'][1]['start'],c['requests'][1]['end']), (len(request()),2*len(request())))
raw = request()+b'GET /'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('trailing incomplete', (c['error'],len(c['requests'])), ({'kind':'incomplete','offset':len(request())},1))
raw = request()+b'GET /\rX'
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('trailing syntax', c['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':len(request())})
raw = b''
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('empty channel', (c['error'],c['committed'],c['bytes']), (None,[],fp(b'')))
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',''),('a','')])
check('zero parts', (c['error'],c['committed']), (None,[0,0]))
# committed counts with split requests
p1 = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n'
p2 = b'Content-Length: 3\r\n'
p3 = b'abc'
p4 = request()
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',p1),('a',p2),('a',p3),('a',p4)])
check('committed split', c['committed'], [0,0,1,2])
check('owners span', c['requests'][0]['owners'], [['a',len(p1)+len(p2)+len(p3)]])
check('end offset', c['requests'][0]['end'], len(p1)+len(p2)+len(p3))

print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
